text:
maya: Heads up — in the last 30m I'm seeing spikes of 503s for streaming endpoints in us-central during GPU pool scale-ups. Noticed correlation with the rolling upgrade window.

dmitri: Which service/logs? streaming-runtime or edge-gateway?

maya: streaming-runtime. example log line:
```
[2026-03-18T02:12:04Z] stream/handshake error: upstream closed connection, code=503, detail=kv-miss priming=false
```

anita: That looks like handshake failures while KV-cache is cold. Our synthetic streaming checks are currently 1r/s per region — that could be contributing to pressure during scale-up.

ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-18 02:05 rolling-update/gpu-pool-us-central - started by infra/auto-roller

sam: Proposal: switch to a 2-stage probe during rollouts — a tiny "priming" call to populate KV + a short generation, then the normal handshake. Also reduce full-stream probe RPS by 5x while autoscaling active.

paul: Cost note: priming calls are small (~0.1 tokens avg) but at global scale they add up. If we have 1r/s * 1000 probe targets = ~8.6M tokens/day. Need to compare that to savings from fewer cold starts.

dmitri: Draft probe config (yaml snippet):
```
probe:
  type: streaming_priming
  priming_sequence: "token_probe"
  priming_timeout_ms: 1500
  full_handshake_after_ms: 2000
  sample_rate: 0.2  # lower when cluster is scaling
  probe_only: true
```

maya: Important: mark priming probes as health-only so they don't count toward user-facing SLOs (we should label metrics accordingly).

anita: We can expose metrics: `synth_priming_tokens_total` and `synth_handshake_failures_total` and tag `probe_variant=priming|full`. Add a Grafana panel that splits priming vs full handshake.

sam: Also add a hysteresis rule: if autoscaler label `scaling_state="up"` then scale probe RPS down 10x for 5m. This avoids probe storms during transient capacity changes.

dmitri: Alert tweak suggestion (prometheus rule style):
```
- alert: SynthHandshakeHighErrorRate
  expr: sum(rate(synth_handshake_failures_total[5m])) by (region) / sum(rate(synth_handshake_checks_total[5m])) by (region) > 0.02
  for: 10m
  labels: {severity: page, team: infra}
```

paul: Quick runbook snippet: if region error_rate > 0.05 -> pause full probes (set sample_rate=0), run priming sweep for 10m, check `kv_warmup_hit_ratio`, and validate downstream 200s. If still failing, roll back the GPU pool update.

maya: I'll open a PR to update the blackbox-config + add the dashboard tile. Assigning to @dmitri for alert rule and @anita for dashboard work. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: PR created: #1234 by maya — "synth priming probe + rollout sampling" (https://git.internal/r/1234)

anita: Can we also run a controlled canary in eu-west today? I want to verify cross-region differences (network RTT + cold KV sizes differ).

sam: From our last experiment, priming reduced token spend for probes by ~80% during rollouts and cut coldstart 503s by ~40%. Worth the engineering time.

dmitri: I'll update prometheus scrape labels to include `probe_variant` and add metadata to distinguish priming probes in metrics. Will also add a per-region sample_rate override.

maya: Thanks — I'll attach PR link and a verification run after the changes land.
